sources.snippet: Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 is a reasoning model: unless told otherwise it opens a <think> block before answering. The bundle declares the thinking channel (thought, <think>\n / \n</think>), so the runtime returns the reasoning separately (the CLI prints it as [thought] … [/thought]) and the answer text carries the answer only.
